name: io.github.flashdata-dev/youtube-search
title: YouTube Search — FlashData
description: YouTube keyword search with filters and up to 20 requested videos. Paid FlashData API.

environmentVariables.name: FLASHDATA_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your FlashData API Key with youtube_search access. Get a key at https://flashdata.dev/app/api-keys; data calls are paid.

dev.flashdata.task: Export YouTube video candidates by keyword
dev.flashdata.useResult: Read results[0].results. Retain videoId, title, channel, channelUrl, viewCount and duration. Construct a watch URL from each videoId for traceable follow-up research.
dev.flashdata.limits: max_results is 1 to 20; actual results can be fewer. Metadata and transcript enrichment are separate paid calls.
dev.flashdata.installation: Local MCPB / stdio; Node.js >=22.18.0; set your own FLASHDATA_API_KEY in protected client settings. See guideUrl for manual setup.
dev.flashdata.billing: MIT software and installation are free. FlashData data calls use paid Credits. Pricing/job/result reads are free; client and model fees are separate.
